dedupe_keys.name: green city clean waters philadelphia combined sewer overflow programme

description: Green City, Clean Waters is Philadelphia's 25-year plan, begun in 2011 under a Consent Order and Agreement with the Pennsylvania Department of Environmental Protection, to cut combined sewer overflows mainly with green stormwater infrastructure (tree trenches, rain gardens, swales, basins) plus treatment-plant and interceptor upgrades. The combined system serves about 60 per cent of the city, and the Philadelphia Water Department must reduce at least 85 per cent of the overflow pollution by 2036. The case is documented through five-yearly Evaluation and Adaptation Plans; the Year 10 plan (30 May 2022, 71 pages plus appendices) reports city-wide progress to 31 December 2021. It tracks Greened Acres (one acre-inch of managed runoff each), overflow volume and percent capture, computed with a rebuilt hydrologic and hydraulic model on the EPA SWMM5 engine for a typical rainfall year, calibrated with flow monitoring, plus receiving-water bacteria models. The plans are available to download as free PDF files from the PWD website, with overviews also in Spanish and Arabic; no licence is stated. Caveats: results are modelled for a typical year, not measured overflow, and the plans are compliance reports written by the utility itself. Simulation uses: a reference for city-scale sewer and drainage modelling, for green infrastructure performance and cost trade-offs, and for adaptation planning under a regulatory target. Related records: EPA SWMM (model-epa-swmm), the International Stormwater BMP Database (data-international-stormwater-bmp-database) and PCSWMM (platform-pcswmm).

notes: The figures are PWD's own compliance reporting. The 2.7 billion gallon figure on the web page and the 3,080 million gallons a year in the Year 10 plan are different measures.
organisations: Pennsylvania Department of Environmental Protection (Consent Order and Agreement)
outcomes: By 31 December 2021 PWD reported meeting or exceeding every Year 10 performance standard: 2,196 Greened Acres against a target of 2,148, overflow volume reduced by 3,080 million gallons a year against 2,044, 9.2 miles of interceptor lined and system-wide percent capture raised to 70.7 per cent.
resources_used: rebuilt hydrologic and hydraulic compliance model (SWMM5)
